summary.text: Imtiaz Mohammad is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 103 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Robin Bartleman.
A business owner, he was the Republican nominee for Florida State Senate District 37 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Imtiaz Mohammad earned a high school diploma from the PAF Academy in Pakistan and a graduate degree from American Intercontinental University in 2003.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an entrepreneur and community leader with an MBA, and said he began his political career in 2015 as a community activist.
Mohammad ran for Florida State Senate District 37 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Jason Pizzo, receiving 93,918 votes (41.8%).
He advanced from the 2026 Republican primary for House District 103 after it was canceled.
In the survey, he said his campaign focuses on rising insurance costs, housing, affordability, transportation and economic development.
